name: Ohio

fees.note: $20 processing + $55 surcharge (width up to 14' and height up to 14'6"), one-way single trip.
$20 processing + $125 overweight surcharge. If also oversize, only this OW surcharge is charged (OAC 5501:2-1-05(B)).
Plus $0.04 per ton over 60 tons per mile: ((GVW - 120,000) / 2000) x Ohio miles x $0.04.

escorts.when: Over 13' wide, on two-lane and other roads
Over 13' wide, on interstates and freeways

restrictions.text: Daylight only (1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset), Sunday-Saturday. No movement from noon the day before until 1/2 hour before sunrise the day after New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas (and the holiday weekend).

Over 12' wide: no movement Sat 3 PM to 1/2 hr before sunrise Sun, Sun 3 PM to 1/2 hr before sunrise Mon, and (Apr 1-Nov 30) Fri 3 PM to 1/2 hr before sunrise Sat. Also no movement 6:30-9:00 AM and 4:30-6:00 PM Mon-Fri in Butler, Clermont, Cuyahoga, Delaware, Fairfield, Franklin, Geauga, Hamilton, Lake, Licking, Lorain, Lucas, Madison, Mahoning, Medina, Montgomery, Pickaway, Stark, Summit, Union, Warren and Wood counties.

Overweight loads that are within legal dimensions are not restricted as to hours or days as long as they do not obstruct normal traffic flow (over-dimension rules above still apply if the load is also oversize).
No travel in adverse weather/road conditions (storms, snow-covered or slippery roads, fog). No convoying within 500' of another permitted load. Stay in the right lane on multi-lane highways.

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

fri from 15:00 (months [4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11]): Fri from 3 P.M., April 1 through November 30

notes: Single trip permit valid up to 5 calendar days (OAC 5501:2-1-03). Return-trip and emergency permits have different fees (not modeled).
Law enforcement escorts: no fixed dimension trigger; required at ODOT's discretion (bridge isolation/structural conditions, or when 8' of reserve pavement can't be kept on two-lane roads).

On multi-lane highways 14' is the maximum width for routine permits; wider = superload with structural/route review. Special engineering analysis or traffic control costs are billed at ODOT's direct cost (OAC 5501:2-1-05(E)).
ODOT permits cover state highways only; county/township roads, city streets and the Ohio Turnpike need separate permission.
Superload also triggered by axle/axle-group weights above the ODOT guide's routine axle limits (not modeled).
